prompt: A photorealistic photo captures a bustling village market at dawn. In the center, an elderly woman in a blue shawl stands holding a woven basket filled with red apples. To her left, a young boy in a striped shirt reaches out to take one of the apples from her basket. Next to the boy, a brown dog sits patiently, looking up at the fruit. Behind them, a wooden stall displays piles of orange carrots, where a farmer in a green hat points toward a large pumpkin resting on the table. A customer in a yellow coat looks at the pumpkin with interest. On the right side of the frame, a baker in a white apron hands a loaf of bread to a girl in a pink dress. The girl holds a silver coin in her palm, ready to pay. Beside the baker, a black cat sleeps on a stack of flour sacks. Near the edge of the scene, a man in a gray suit checks his pocket watch while standing next to a bicycle leaning against a stone wall. A parrot in a cage hangs from the stall's roof, watching the crowd below. An old man in a brown cap sits on a wooden crate, tying his shoelaces. A woman in a floral dress walks past him, carrying a bundle of fresh herbs. A rooster struts across the cobblestones near a pile of empty crates. A child in a blue jacket plays with a wooden toy car on the ground. A vendor in a purple vest arranges jars of honey on a shelf. A stray goat eats grass near the wheel of a cart. There is no modern technology visible in the scene. There is no rain falling from the sky. There is no artificial lighting illuminating the market.
